clips.start_words: You breathe in through the nose
clips.send: Someone having a stressful week sends this to a friend who's always anxious - practical value, something they can actually do right now.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's simple stress reset: breathe in through the nose, out through the nose. Relax your face, relax your stomach, attention two inches below your belly button. Five breaths, several times a day.

His claim: your body relaxes and stress and anxiety go down.

His second tool is meditation - even five minutes, once a week, beats none. His own ideal is 20 minutes before breakfast and 20 minutes before dinner.

Which one would you actually try today, the breathing or the meditation?

#kevintrudeau #stressrelief #breathing #meditation #wbdaily #healthtruth

clips.end_words: you are just going to feel better
clips.send: Someone who just found out they have hidden food sensitivities sends this to a friend who's always a little puffy or tired - a small, usable fix.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's next tool for stress: a hyperbaric chamber. His claim: flooding your body with oxygen - either at a medical-grade facility or a lower-pressure home unit - leaves you feeling better.

His next point: most people have a histamine issue and don't know it. Certain foods activate histamine, triggering mild allergic reactions that quietly wear you down.

His suggestion: a histamine scavenger or blocker can reduce that load.

What's one food that always seems to leave you feeling off?
